annotation_rule: Inspect RGB and 2D boxes only. Mark paired cup/mug on paired table true, clearly on another surface false, uncertain null. Save labels before depth or 3D reference inspection.
support_proposal: Unchanged cup/mug footpoint inside surface box and median-depth gap <=0.75m.
development_basis: The local-surface method failed on 13 previously inspected positive pairs. A radial camera-ray correction was tested on those development pairs only. Parent radial sigma 0.2m gave 0.206m mean child error against 0.250m exact contact; chosen before this selection's images or 3D data were viewed.
primary_metric: Paired mean child 3D centroid error in metres, radial minus exact contact, on all visually positive pairs using oracle 2D boxes and relations
secondary_metrics: pair detection and support proposal coverage
claim_limits: All remaining 15 uniquely paired train-split candidates, including nearby frames and possibly repeated rooms. Official intrinsics, manual offset, one visual annotator. A result here alone cannot establish novelty against published radial or scene-optimization methods. No parameter tuning after unblinding.
